items.title: PBS dispute could see MS patients pay $33k a year for crucial drugs
items.description: The latest PBS stoush with drugmakers means thousands of people with MS are at risk of being forced to pay $33,000 a year for lifesaving medication.

items.title: Huge arms deals struck at NATO, but Trump 'disappointed' with leaders
items.description: In a sign they are heeding calls from the United States to spend more to defend Europe, NATO leaders agree to deals estimated to be worth at least $72 billion.

items.title: Video shows men who attended Khamenei's funeral and the man who didn't
items.description: The strictly choreographed funeral of Iran's former supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has presented a rare insight into the image Tehran wants to project to the world and the men they see as central to it.

items.title: How this school cracked the code to close the gap in early reading
items.description: An inspiring turnaround at an Aboriginal community school could provide a scalable solution for closing the gap on Indigenous literacy.

items.title: Marine Le Pen to enter French presidential race as court trims ban
items.description: The court in Paris upheld Marine Le Pen's conviction for misusing EU funds but shortened her ban on running for elected office.

items.title: Farage quits as an MP but vows to win 'circus' by-election
items.description: Nigel Farage, the far-right political leader riding a surge of support in Britain, has announced a major gamble that could end his political career.

items.title: Prince Harry loses privacy case against Daily Mail, calls ruling 'whitewash'
items.description: Prince Harry and six other claimants, including singer Elton John, have lost their claims against Daily Mail's publisher after alleging their phones were tapped, voicemails intercepted and personal information obtained through deception.

items.title: Monaco bomb suspect found dead near Kyiv
items.description: A Ukrainian woman suspected of a bomb attack that targeted a wealthy Ukrainian-born businessman in Monaco has been found shot dead in Ukraine, according to Ukraine's prosecutor general's office.

items.title: Live: Messi leads incredible Argentina comeback as Egypt blows 2-0 lead
items.description: Lionel Messi guides Argentina to an incredible comeback win against Egypt, coming back from 2-0 down to steal a 3-2 win at the death. Follow live.

items.title: Qantas customers warned not to delete email about $105m settlement
items.description: More than 1 million Qantas customers are being notified they may be eligible for access to a multi-million-dollar settlement.

items.title: 'Completely unimaginable': Man critically injured in robot vacuum fire
items.description: The family of a Perth man critically injured when a robot vacuum caught fire at his home say their lives have been "turned upside down" by the "horrific" incident.

items.title: Explosions rock Damascus near hotel hosting French President Macron
items.description: French officials say Mr Macron did not hear the blasts, and his motorcade continued through the streets of the Syrian capital to a meeting with Syrian President Ahmed Al-Sharaa, in the first by a European head of state since 2024.

items.title: YouTube doubles down on 'false flag' video about Bondi Beach victim
items.description: YouTube's head of policy tells the Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion a video calling the Bondi Beach terror attack a "false flag" does not breach its hate speech policies.

items.title: Officer filmed punching man was using 'approved manoeuvre', police say
items.description: NSW Police say an officer filmed repeatedly punching a man in the back of the head on in Western Sydney on Monday night was using an "approved manoeuvre".

items.title: Quiz: Jump in, we're going on a trip around the world
items.description: Which Mediterranean island was a setting for The Godfather? And what's the capital city of Morocco?

items.title: Five podcasts we're listening to this NAIDOC Week
items.description: Some of our favourite Indigenous-led podcasts this week and every week include interviews with AFL greats, a dive into Aboriginal astronomy, and conversations with a renowned artist who loves Dolly Parton.

items.title: What you need to know before claiming your phone as a tax deduction
items.description: The cost of buying and using your own phone may be tax deductible, but the ATO has specific rules about how employees calculate these expenses.

items.title: With just one warhead, China sends a reminder of growing military capacity
items.description: This latest military test demonstrates China's growing willingness to use its military strength to send a warning to the Pacific: that Beijing now has the military and nuclear means to assert its dominance in the region.

items.title: Embattled MP Moira Deeming apologises to supporters in social media video
items.description: The Liberal MP thanked her supporters and apologised for "distractions" in a video posted to her Facebook page, as questions still loom over her political future.

items.title: Accused double killer Beau Lamarre-Condon's mother granted bail
items.description: Coleen Lamarre has been in custody since April, when she was arrested in Sydney's inner west accused of attempting to influence a key witness in her son's upcoming double murder trial.

items.title: 'My role model': Younger brother speaks after death of Melbourne footballer
items.description: The younger brother of footy player and teacher Nathan Fitzgerald, who died last night, has described him as a "gentle, wonderful" soul who cherished his family.

items.title: Brisbane runner 'hesitant' to report harassment ordeal
items.description: A Brisbane mother says police can improve the way they respond to harassment complaints after she was followed by a car during her morning run.

items.title: US toddler found in pool and declared dead later found alive
items.description: Five hours after the young boy was pronounced dead next to a suburban swimming pool in the US state of Arizona, police were notified that the child was breathing again at a local hospital.

items.title: A frame-by-frame look at Balogun's infamous red card tackle
items.description: While many agree the red card call was too harsh, the story has become a bigger discussion about FIFA's integrity.
